details: On load, the package runs a bundled dropper (_shim.js) that fingerprints the OS/architecture and downloads a binary payload over HTTPS from three Cloudflare Workers hosts (oob-worker[.]cf103-070[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf101-adf[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf100-416[.]workers[.]dev) at per-platform paths /pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, and /pkg/package.exe. If the HTTP download fails it falls back to a DNS-TXT command channel under the domains sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, ext[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, pkg[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, and net[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru (querying c.<domain> for a chunk count, then base64 chunks from N.<domain>). The downloaded payload is written to /var/tmp/.cache_<hex> (or dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe in TEMP on Windows), made executable, and launched as a detached background process via /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe start /b. The package also writes a marker file (~/.analytics_state or %TEMP%\analytics_state) to throttle re-execution.
